checks: 8 fixed-time reference altitude sweeps with paired physical output, layer controls and one-meter boundary refinement

measurement.region: 4x4 box RGB samples every eight screen pixels. Ellipsoid miss for sky, intersection at 20 km or farther for aerial perspective, all surface hits for terrain lighting.
measurement.controls: display = original, cloud = original minus no clouds, transport = unlit surface/sky with atmosphere minus its vacuum result, terrain light = clear lit minus clear unlit, cirrus = original minus the same cloud field with only its high deck disabled.
measurement.refinement: Bisect any adjacent pair with a component mean over six RGB codes, or over 12% of common blocks changing by more than 16 codes. Persistent signals at one meter fail with both native images.
